# Case `C01_perfect_mixer`

**Category:** control (Controls with numerical kill criteria)
**Source:** synthetic · **Split:** holdout

## Why it is in the matrix

The degenerate bound: a single-cell pad with no geometry at all, so a reclaim cut is a tonnage-weighted mean of everything in the pile. The achieved VRR must equal the independent-layer bound.

## Expected behaviour

Achieved VRR equal to 1/N within the multi-seed band

## Kill criterion

> If the achieved VRR differs from 1/N by more than the band, the VRR implementation is wrong and every number in the product is suspect

This is the statement that turns the case from a demonstration into a test. It says, in advance, what
result would mean the code is wrong, and the release gate fails the bake when it is violated.

## Configuration

| parameter | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| `stacking` | `coneshell` | the deposition path over the pad |
| `reclaim` | `fullface` | which cells the machine engages and how deep it reaches |
| `n_passes` | 1 | stacker passes, that is layers: the N of the 1/N bound |
| `sr` | 1.0 | the Gray-Thornton segregation number; 0 is a passive tracer |
| `repose_deg` | 37.0 | the imposed angle of repose of the fine species |
| `repose_coarse_deg` | 37.0 | the coarse species; a positive difference is Makse |
| `structure` | `short_range` | the autocorrelation structure of the incoming stream |
| `range_t` | 4000 t | the practical range of the input variogram, in tonnes |
| `n_dumps` | 240 | truck loads in the build |
| `reclaim_rate` | 1.0 | tonnes reclaimed per tonne stacked |
| `cut_tonnes` | 2400 t | the parcel size the plant receives |
| pad | 1 x 1 cells at 40.0 m | 40 by 40 metres |

## Operating regimes

This case carries **no variants**, and that is deliberate. It is a control: one point with a numerical kill criterion. Sweeping it would destroy the property that makes it a control, and padding the list to reach a count would be fabricating regimes.

## Reproduce it

```bash
python data-pipeline/run.py C01_perfect_mixer --output build/check --band-seeds 5
```

Omit `--output` only for an intentional canonical release bake. Everything about this case is a pure
function of its parameters and the seed, so two runs produce a byte-identical trace.
